Exactly where the physical minimum-area rule bites, and what it costs, for each burned-area definition. The floor is 0.36 ha = 4 cells of 30 m. It is applied twice, identically on both sides: once to connected components (step 1) and once to the zone x land-cover units they are split into (step 2), because a component above the floor can still be cut by land cover into slivers below it. A single-cell component is removed at step 1 and therefore never becomes a unit, never enters a ranking and never appears on a map.

**Sources (column → raster / array).**

- `components` — 8-connected (3x3 structure) of the burned mask
- `units` — component x 2018 land-cover class
- `floor` — MIN_UNIT_HA = 0.36 ha (MIN_UNIT_PX = 4 cells at 30 m)
